finalAnswer:
Done — I added the 2021 total freshwater withdrawals by country layer to the map.

It uses the supplied frozen World Bank 2021 country indicator in billion m³ per year, joined exactly from `ISO_A3` to `Country Code`. The legend uses five quantile classes for the 183 known country values, with breaks at 0.264674, 1.260696, 4.0702, and 13.261644 billion m³/year; values on a break go into the upper class. A separate neutral No data class covers 68 countries.

Important limitation: this is a country-level 2021 indicator only, not a subnational surface or a new regional aggregation. All 251 supplied country features were retained, and the 68 unknown countries stay as No data where the exact code join did not match or the supplied 2021 value was missing.

Sources: Terra-hosted frozen GeoBenchX World Bank country boundaries and frozen GeoBenchX World Development Indicators ER.H2O.FWTL.K3 (2021), retrieved in this run on 2026-10-07 UTC. You can inspect any country on the map to see its `benchmark_row_id`, value, and class.

- Countries with unmatched ISO_A3/Country Code values or missing supplied 2021 measurements remain No data.
- The legend is quantile-based on the 183 known country values only; 68 countries remain No data.
- 68 countries remain No data because their supplied ISO_A3 did not match a supplied Country Code exactly or the supplied 2021 value is missing.
- This is a country-level 2021 indicator layer only. It is not a subnational surface and not a new regional aggregation.
- The quantile legend is based on the 183 known country values only.
- The output keeps all supplied country features, including features whose ISO_A3 does not match a supplied Country Code.
- Only the supplied 2021 indicator values are used; missing supplied values remain unknown.
- The exact join leaves unmatched or missing countries as No data instead of guessing values.
- The quantile legend is based on the 183 known country values only; 68 countries are in No data.
